purpose: One-page summary of a company's current raise and the qualified investor contacts for it: the deal profile extracted from the pitch deck, qualified contact counts by category, the top contacts per category with a fit rationale, material gaps and screening limitations, and the number of investors already introduced. Detailed contact information stays in the companion workbook.
rules: The template holds structure only; every value is filled from a run.
Deal-profile values come only from the deck or from recorded user overrides; missing values read 'not stated in deck'.
Conflicting deck values are shown as conflicts, never resolved silently.
Only qualified contacts are shown; thin categories are never padded.
No emails, phone numbers or LinkedIn URLs on the page; they stay in the workbook.
Text is shortened (reduction ladder), never shrunk below the minimum body size.

meta_fields.label: Raise
meta_fields.format: joined:' · '; stage and instrument omitted when not stated

meta_fields.label: Deck date
meta_fields.format: date as stated; '(file metadata)' suffix when taken from file properties

fact_statuses.meaning: One value found in the deck; cited to its slide/page.
Sector/subsector inferred from deck vocabulary; confirm before sending.
Remaining = raise − signed/committed, only for the same round, currency and date; shown with '(calculated)'.
Deck date taken from file properties because no date is on the title or closing slide.
Different values in the deck; shown as 'conflicting figures — A vs B' and not used until resolved.

sections.title: Deal profile
sections.description: 5–6 compact bullets built from the effective deal profile (deck facts, or user overrides where recorded). Each bullet ends with the slide/page references of its facts.
sections.optional_segment_rule: A [[...]] segment is dropped when its field is not stated or repeats the company name.

sections.title: Qualified contacts
sections.description: Counts must equal the row counts in the companion workbook.

rows.label: {category}
rows.source: count of Ranked Investors rows per category

rows.label: Held for review
rows.source: count of REVIEW rows in Exclusions and Review

sections.title: Top contacts by category (full ranked list in the Excel export)
sections.description: Up to the top contacts per category from the ranked list, in category order, then Fit Score, evidence completeness, organization and name.
sections.empty_group_text: No qualified contacts in this category.

columns.label: Why a fit
columns.source: documented evidence per score component; inferences labelled '(inferred)'

sections.title: Material gaps and screening limitations
sections.description: Run limitations in priority order: deck conflicts, fields not established, calculated values, classification notes, prior-introduction screening completeness, review items, low-evidence contacts, email-deliverability disclaimer, OCR gaps.
sections.overflow_pattern: {n} more limitation(s) listed on the Deal Profile sheet.

closing_note.pattern: {already_introduced} investor(s) already introduced to this company are excluded (see Already Introduced, marked “do not re-intro”). Full exports: {workbook_file} — {sheet_list}. Contact details are kept in the spreadsheet only.

categories.label: VCs (Seed & Early-Stage)
categories.definition: Seed and early-stage venture funds, including corporate VCs.

footer.standard_line_pattern: {document_title}     {page}     Compiled on {report_date} by TEN Capital Network

layout_checks: every text span inside the page bounds
every shortlisted contact name present in full

companion_workbook.sheet_rules: Filters and frozen header row on every sheet; readable widths; text stored as literal strings (formula-safe); missing optional contact fields read 'needs research'.
